The artist

About Samarth

A contemporary Indian voice, bringing Hindi-Punjabi stories to life through melody, mood, and honest songwriting.

His story

From feeling to song

Samarth is a Delhi-based Hindi-Punjabi singer-songwriter and composer creating a sound shaped by emotion, contemporary production, and memorable melody.

His debut track, “DUA,” arrived in 2022 and drew attention in the Hindi soothing-music space, introducing an intimate style built on restraint and sincerity.

Following DUA, “ARZIYAN” became Samarth’s most-streamed song at the time and carried his music to a growing audience of young listeners in India and beyond.

In February 2024, “JAANE” expanded his sound into Punjabi and hip-hop influences and earned a place on Spotify’s Viral 50. Across every release, Samarth’s focus remains honest writing, innovative sound, and songs worth returning to.
